submissions.findingTextShort: Pedicularis groenlandica extracts contain measurable phenolic and flavonoid fractions.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: Preclinical extract profiling of Pedicularis groenlandica found measurable total phenolic and flavonoid content; the methanol extract had the highest reported totals at 95.78 mg GAE/g phenolics and 66.90 mg QE/g flavonoids, while the study did not isolate individual clinically active compounds.
submissions.mechanismContext: Preclinical phytochemical extract characterization; bulk phenolic and flavonoid assays rather than isolated constituent identification.
submissions.uncertaintyNote: These are extract-level laboratory measurements and do not establish human efficacy, clinical dosing, or the identity and contribution of individual active compounds.
